text:
Alex: Heads-up — saw slow memory growth and eviction stalls in KV when kernel-selector flips between kernels during long Qwen-XL runs. Repro on 0.9.14; wasn't present on 0.9.12.

Maria: Can you paste a minimal repro? Is this MQA/GQA specific or model-wide?

Alex: Repro steps (short):
```
# start runtime with kernel-heuristic=dynamic
./bench_kv_repro --model qwen-xl --ctx 32768 --seq-distribution long --toggle-kernel=on
# hit steady state with ~200 concurrent streams for ~30m
# observe RSS on runner host and kv_page table (pmap)
```
Observed: RSS creeps up, evictions/sec drops to near-0 for extended periods, and many pages show refcount > 0 even though no active requests reference them.

Jin: Interesting. Is this only after a kernel switch (e.g. MQA->GQA) while rope-scaling is active?

Alex: Yes — tested combinations. If rope-scaling disabled, the leak isn't reproducible. Pattern: kernel selector switches kernels for a subset of shards, then coalescer seems to create "ghost blocks" (pages linked but not reusable).

Maria: I captured a short profiler snippet during the stall: 
```
KV: page_total=524288 page_in_use=421312 page_free=1024
coalescer: merges=3122 skip_due_to_owner_mismatch=1987
evictor: attempts=4320 success=12 avg_latency_ms=120.4
page_refcounts: majority show 1-3, ~1200 show >5
```
Notice skip_due_to_owner_mismatch spikes when the kernelID changes.

Samir: That sounds like a coalescer invariant break — if owner/tag isn't updated atomically when kernel switching, pages can be skipped by the reclaim path. I remember a similar race where coalescer walks spans and bails on mismatched "owner_epoch". Could be the kernel selection path doesn't propagate the new tag before the coalescer snapshot.

Alex: Agreed. Also saw that KV metadata `last_touched_epoch` is stale for many blocks; evictor uses that to prioritize. If it's stale the blocks never get chosen for eviction.

Jin: Any kernel logs? Can you dump a short stack trace where coalescer counts skip_due_to_owner_mismatch?

Alex: Pasted a small log window: 
```
[2026-03-12 14:32:11.322] coalescer: walk span 0x7f9e1e0 skip owner=0x2 -> current_owner=0x5
[2026-03-12 14:32:11.322] evictor: candidate 0x7f9e1e0 refcnt=6 last_touched=1649241887
[2026-03-12 14:32:11.323] kernel-select: switched shard 3 -> kernel=gqa (commit 3a7b9f2)
```
Note refcnt shouldn't be 6 for an evictable page.

Samir: Can you bisect which commit introduced the kernel-select ordering change? I suspect 3a7b9f2 or the follow-up that changed when tag update happens.

Alex: I bisected to commit 3a7b9f2 and verified 0.9.13 has the regression when combined with rope-scaling heuristic 'adaptive'.

Maria: Perf numbers from local runs: before (0.9.12) evict_success_rate ~ 92%, evictions/sec ~ 1200. After (0.9.14) evict_success_rate ~ 0.3%, evictions/sec ~ 18, KV memory steady growth ~ +1.2GB/hr under 32k context.

Jin: OK. Action items: 1) add a small unit test that flips kernel tags while coalescer is walking spans, 2) instrument coalescer to assert owner/tag freshness, 3) add a short-lived background reaper that forcibly clears stale last_touched for queued pages as a mitigation. I'll own the bisect + test.

Samir: +1. Also open IN-4152 and attach logs/heap profile. If reaper helps, make it opt-in behind a runtime flag and add telemetry for skip_due_to_owner_mismatch.

ops-bot: CI: Test suite triggered for branch jin/kv-coalesce-fix — 42 jobs queued.

Alex: I'll attach the heap profiles and the reproducer config to IN-4152. Thanks — ping me if you need the long-run cluster access. :thumbsup:

Maria: One more note — Qwen variants with larger kv-page slabs (4MB) show the behavior faster. Might be slab size interacting with coalescer stride.

Jin: Got it. I'll start with a small repro on dev cluster and replicate the pmap output. Assigning to myself, will update by EOD.

Alex: Thanks all. If anyone hits this in the wild, please tag IN-4152 and `@eng-runtime`.
